Let me create pair 1 with background 4 and dots in various blocks.

Block (1,1): rows 5-9, cols 5-9. Place dot at (7,7).
Block (2,2): rows 10-14, cols 10-14. Place dot at (12,12).

Pair 2: background 3, dots in (0,2),(2,0). Also maybe two dots in same block.

Pair 3: background 6, dots in (1,0),(1,2),(0,1).

Let me write these grids.
